SVG 转换：全部可用目标SVG conversions: every available target

SVG 是代码描述的图形，不是像素。写进 HTML 时它保持矢量，但脚本、事件处理器与远程引用会在净化时被剥离；转成图片、PDF 或 Word 时先栅格化成 PNG，于是缩放不再无损。浏览器不能写 SVG，所以它只能作为源格式。An SVG describes a drawing in code rather than pixels. Written into HTML it stays vector, but scripts, event handlers and remote references are stripped during sanitisation; turning it into an image, PDF or Word rasterises it to PNG first, so scaling stops being lossless. Browsers cannot write SVG, which is why it is source-only.

这个来源格式的共同限制What holds for every target from this source

  • SVG 不是可写格式：目标列表里不会出现它，转换只能从它出发SVG is not writable: it never appears as a target, only as a starting point
  • 脚本、内联事件、外部 `<use>` 与远程图片在净化或栅格化前被剥离；动效与交互不会保留Scripts, inline events, external `<use>` and remote images are stripped before sanitising or rasterising; animation and interaction do not survive
  • 转图片、PDF、Word 都经过 PNG 栅格化：矢量边缘变成像素，缩放不再无损Images, PDF and Word go through PNG rasterisation: vector edges become pixels and scaling stops being lossless
  • 没有 OCR；图片到 TXT、CSV、JSON、Excel 的组合被置灰并说明No OCR; image to TXT, CSV, JSON and Excel are greyed out with a reason

常见问题Questions people actually ask

SVG 里的脚本会执行吗？Do scripts inside an SVG run?

不会。SVG 在进入 HTML 或栅格化之前先被净化：`<script>`、事件属性、外部引用与 `javascript:` 地址全部移除。图形保留，行为不保留。No. The SVG is sanitised before it enters HTML or a rasteriser: `<script>`, event attributes, external references and `javascript:` URLs are all removed. The drawing stays; the behaviour does not.

SVG 转 PNG 会变模糊吗？Does SVG to PNG become blurry?

栅格化后就是位图，放大到超过栅格尺寸才会模糊；输出时按画布与 MAX_DIM 决定像素。要无限缩放，请继续使用 SVG。Once rasterised it is a bitmap, and blur appears only when it is scaled beyond the raster size. The output pixels follow the canvas and MAX_DIM. For unlimited scaling, keep the SVG.

SVG 转 HTML 还是矢量的吗？Is SVG to HTML still vector?

是。净化后的 SVG 标记直接进入 HTML，浏览器按矢量渲染；远程字体、图片与脚本引用被剥离，所以外观可能与原页面不同。Yes. The sanitised SVG markup goes straight into the HTML and the browser renders it as vector. Remote fonts, images and script references are stripped, so it can look different from the original page.

图表里的文字能编辑吗？Is text inside a chart editable?

转 HTML 时它仍是 SVG 文本，能在源码里改；转成 PNG、PDF 或 Word 后就是像素，没有文字层。需要可编辑的图表文字，请选 HTML 或保留 SVG 源文件。In HTML it remains SVG text and can be edited in the source. As PNG, PDF or Word it is pixels with no text layer. For editable chart labels, choose HTML or keep the SVG source.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
